reviews.comment: Mid lecturer, and he barely responds to emails. His exams are similar to his exam review which is helpful, but his work is hard to understand. Overall, you can probably get a good grade in the class but he makes it so that it is a lot of self learning. Not a bad guy though, but it was frustrating not being able to have my questions answered well.

Interesting class opening up how hardware and software are connected. Lecture slides were right out of textbook. Coming to class not necessary to understand material, but had an attendance grade. Weekly Canvas quizzes and long lab assignments. Professor Muzahid didn't seem to put much effort into the class (he likely cares more about his research).
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Over 50 percent of the class ended up with a C which just blows my mind into the oblivion. Some of the questions for the midterm papers are based on examples that I had never seen in my life. You will have a better time creating your own structure for a pc rather than trying to understand the lecture slides which are basically SSs of the TB.

He's pretty solid overall, not as terrible as other people say. Really nice guy and he's super chill. He's one of those profs that won't be too much of a stickler over anything. If you want to do well just make sure to pay attention in class and read the textbook.

This is hands down the worst professor I have ever had. Do not take him at all costs. He does not explain things well at all. You cannot understand as he mumbles, has a thick accent, and talks quickly. I would rate a zero if I could. Again, do not take at all costs. Opposite of inspiring if you are thinking about going into computers.

Read the textbook when he recommends it, its necessary. Other reviews make it seem like he's horrible, but he is actually quite nice. Really caring and wants you to learn, but unfortunately his lecture slides are vague at times and his explaining isn't the best. If you read the textbook like recommends and go to class, you'll be fine for sure.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is one of the worst, least understandable, most confusing professor I have ever had. Avoid at all costs. His accent is very thick. The labs for this class are long and tedious. His online lectures are of no help. There was almost no learning involved, just hang on and pray.

He's an ok prof, nothing amazing. He is a nice guy though. He tries to help the students but it looks like he struggles to explain it in a way the student can understand. Labs and quizzes weren't too bad but the ffirst exam went terribly mainly because of the amount of time allotted. Hopefully he changes this for the final exam...

Honestly worst professor Ive ever had. Hes a major push over so you may get him to do a few favors for you, but his lectures are monotone and not even that helpful. He will never do anything he says he will, pushes back due dates constantly due to lack of adequate teaching, doesnt give many assignments when he said he would. Very frustrating
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Reading the powerpoints are generally more informative than trying to understand lecture and even then they are vague at best. In a similar vein, prepare to be absolutely stumped as to what the labs are asking for. Pop quizzes which quiz you on things you won't understand until you have time to read. Arduously long homeworks with too many points.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy
